script: Keep one notebook, or one free Google Doc called My Digital Career. Write your answers to every exercise there. By the end, you will have your own simple business plan, made by you, for your own life. Be honest with yourself about what this course can and cannot promise. It does not promise a fixed income or overnight success. Many women earn their first money within two to three months of steady effort. Some take a little longer. Income grows with skill, good reviews and repeat clients. Choose a regular time for learning. Forty-five minutes a day, five days a week, is a good start. If you have less time, learn in two short sittings, but do not skip the practice. People who stop usually do so because they watched and never did the work. Each video follows the same pattern. First, a short title card. Then the main ideas, shown as simple drawings, with one step on screen at a time. At the end, the checklist for the chapter appears, so that you can check your progress.
